explanation.definitionFit: The nickname describes someone ostentatiously flush with cash, a person who already has plenty of money.

explanation.definitionFit: In American football a lineman plays on the line of scrimmage, blocking or tackling, so it names a kind of player.

clue.text: Kind friend scoffed portion of chops
